title: Studio Hub
description: Web productivity tool for a game studio that makes it easy to access and preview game assets. Built end to end with AI and deployed on Google Cloud.
fullDescription:
Studio Hub is a web productivity tool built for a game studio, where I have worked since May 2026. I developed the entire project: database, backend, frontend, and deployment on Google Cloud.

The system's goal is to make game assets easier to access, allowing users to preview animations, audio, and all other game assets.

The project was built entirely with AI assistance. The architecture and the rules given to the AI were defined from patterns of my other React projects, which use a modular architecture.

Through this project, I developed Google Cloud skills and cloud cost control.
roleDescription: Responsible for the complete development of the tool, including database, backend, frontend, and cloud deployment.
responsibilities: Designed and managed data models with PostgreSQL
Developed the backend using Server Functions
Built the interface with React and data fetching with TanStack Query
Defined the modular architecture and rules for AI-assisted development
Deployed and operated the application on Google Cloud
